items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: my right arm in that band was another piano player -- Buster Harding... even Chick Webb -- Chick Webb Bardu Ali would play the theatres... I would stand in front... Buster would take over on the piano

ctx.x: And then, my right arm in that band was another piano player -- Buster Harding. Buster Harding was my main man for arranging, and a lot of times he'd play piano in the band and I'd stand up in front, because the agents figured that in those days they always would have a front man in the band, and even Chick Webb -- Chick Webb Bardu Ali would play the theatres, he would hire to stand in front of the band with a stick so the agents felt that unless I was being featured on the piano and was playing in the rhythm…
What's the name of that ballroom?
